name: Chainhead
source:
Chainhead is the brother of Head Cadaver. Their appearances are similar by the fact their faces are almost completely concealed. Chainhead's face, biceps, forearms, hands and waist are wrapped with chains and bolted to his skin. A heavy metal hook is attached to the very end.

Head Cadaver uses he/it pronouns for Chainhead which Darcy notices. It is suggested to look disfigured underneath the chains, or have something else 'wrong' with them.
